svg.title: Figure 2.3 — Candidate areas before reducing chart clutter (illustrative chart).
svg.desc: An illustrative chart with candidate areas, some overlapping or less relevant.

cc:Work.dc:description: Illustrative chart with seven subdued candidate horizontal bands: some overlap, some mark minor movement, one is far from current price, and key structure is mixed with clutter.
